footnotes: Run 3 (box-6) was measured again on 2026-11-12/13, on the same box, with a collector that records which cgroup the kernel charges for the box's filesystem-metadata writeback; it replaces the run of 2026-11-10 (`data/2026/superseded/cycle-3/`). That run was charged 16.6 MB of disk writes in its first seven hours; this one was charged 4 KB in 25 hours, while the box's metadata writeback (150 MB over the run) was charged to other cgroups throughout. `docs/RUN-2026-slot5.md` has the cause and the rule under which the run was replaced.

The memory peak (118 MB) is reached before the first sample, within seconds of the install: the cgroup's high-water mark is already 117 MB there while it holds 8 MB, and it holds about 8 MB for the rest of the run.
